availability.value: On sale; assembled locally by Regal Automobiles at Manga Mandi, Lahore, the first electric SUV built in Pakistan. Delivery in about 4 months (PakWheels). A 22 kW wall charger was included free at launch.
availability.note: Gari.pk and PKRevenue launch reports; PakWheels for the delivery time.

notes.value: Seres 3, the compact electric SUV that Regal Automobiles assembles in Lahore (Manga Mandi), the first electric SUV built in Pakistan. One version is listed for 2026 (PakWheels, Gari.pk): 54 kWh ternary-lithium battery, front motor with 120 kW (161 hp) and 300 Nm, front-wheel drive, 0–100 km/h in 8.9 s, 160 km/h, 403 km on the NEDC cycle. At launch Regal also announced a 49.34 kWh version; pre-orders received the 54 kWh car. Charging through CCS2: DC 20–80% in about 30 minutes, AC 6.6 kW in about 6 hours; a 22 kW wall charger was free at launch. 4,385 × 1,850 × 1,650 mm on a 2,655 mm wheelbase, 180 mm ground clearance, 18-inch alloys on 225/55 R18, 526 L boot, 1,650 kg, 5 seats; MacPherson front and torsion-beam rear suspension, discs all round. Equipment includes 6 airbags, a 360° camera, front and rear parking sensors, lane departure and forward collision warning, a 10.25-inch touchscreen with wireless phone connectivity, 6 speakers, leather 6-way electric heated front seats, automatic climate control, an electric panoramic sunroof and a foot-sensor power tailgate. PKR 8,390,000 ex-factory. Warranty 5 years / 100,000 km, battery and motor 8 years / 150,000 km. Sources: PakWheels, Gari.pk, Business Recorder, Profit, PKRevenue. PakWheels' spec table contradicts itself in places (a 331 km range, '0 Nm' torque, night vision), so only figures that agree with other Pakistani sources are used.
